messages:
Alex (AE): kicking off a POC conversation with CoreRetail — they want to validate recommendations/assistant for merchant support. asking for scope + acceptance criteria so we can price and timeline.
Priya (Solutions Eng): can we confirm primary use cases? assistant for agent augmentation (short answers + suggested responses) and a search+routing recommender for tickets? short convo-style prompts or long context? :thinking:
Matt (Customer CTO): both. main flow is short Q/A with product and order context (customer id, order history). occasional long context for disputes (~2-3k tokens).
Sam (ML Eng): for quality evals we should ask for 100–200 labeled prompt/response pairs across priority intents (returns, shipping, refunds). will run A/B vs their baseline scorer.
Alex (AE): timeline ask: customer wants a two-week hands-on POC and then decision meeting. can we commit to a minimal setup in 10 business days?
Priya (Solutions Eng): yes if they provide eval sets + sample traffic. Day 0–2: infra + creds; Day 3–7: model config + prompts; Day 8–12: run evaluations + iterate; Day 13–14: handoff + acceptance demo.
Helen (Security): security checklist: they require VPC peering or Private deployment, KMS for keys, SOC2 evidence, and data retention controls. also need to confirm we can disable logging of PII fields.
Priya (Solutions Eng): we can offer Redwood Private in their VPC or Dedicated with a strict logging policy. need their security questionnaire (SQ) filled out. Helen can own answers for infra controls.
Helen (Security): I'll take SQ. Matt, can you push the internal legal/Sec contacts to sign the NDA? we need that before exchanging sample customer PII.
Matt (Customer CTO): NDA sent this morning — legal will loop in later today. for PII we can anonymize or provide synthetic variants if you prefer.
Sam (ML Eng): acceptance KPIs proposal:
- Latency: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for short prompts (<=512 tokens)
- Cost: avg inference $$ per 1k tokens (we'll provide a range in the pricing doc) — target to be < their current per-interaction cost
- Quality: accuracy/acceptance on eval set >= 88% (intent match + answer correctness), or reduction in escalation rate by >= 20% during POC
Alex (AE): that'll be the commercial anchor — if we hit those metrics, they move to reserved capacity commit.
Priya (Solutions Eng): tech notes for the POC run:
```
model: redwood-2-small (quantized)
mode: hosted -> dedicated fallback
cache: enable prefix caching for agent prompts
batching: 16 reqs / 0.2s window (adjust after early metrics)
metrics: token-level latency, per-prompt quality labels, cost-per-request
```
Sam (ML Eng): also will add a small eval harness script. example eval call:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-small","prompt":"{{prompt}}","max_tokens":150}'
```
Alex (AE): pricing questions from buyer: do we bill during POC? they asked for credit vs measured billing.
Priya (Solutions Eng): standard is free credits for 2-week POC up to X compute hours, then measured billing if they exceed. for Dedicated/Private we use a short trial commitment.
Matt (Customer CTO): can we get a simple estimate of expected monthly cost at 100k interactions/mo? need to evaluate TCO.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble a cost model after the first week of run metrics. initial rough estimate depends on model choice and quantization; we can provide low/med/high scenarios.
Helen (Security): also confirm audit logs will be available for all requests during POC and retained for 90 days — customer requested that.
Priya (Solutions Eng): yes we can enable request-level audit logs and mask PII fields (we'll need the fields identified or regex patterns).
Alex (AE): next actions: 1) Matt to confirm SQ/NDA timeframe; 2) Customer to upload eval set and sample traffic; 3) Priya & Sam to standby for infra on Day 0. I'll draft the POC SOW today and share.
Matt (Customer CTO): will push SQ answers and confirm timeline by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Solutions Eng): noted. I'll draft a minimal SOW with milestones and acceptance test steps. will include concrete thresholds (latency/cost/quality) and rollback/fallback plan.
Alex (AE): thanks all. tagging @deploy-bot for a quick reminder to provision a POC cluster on 1742090000
deploy-bot: scheduled: provision-poc-cluster for core-retail at 1742090000 — owner: Priya (Solutions Eng) :white_check_mark:
Priya (Solutions Eng): great, i'll post the onboarding checklist in this thread once infra is live. :thumbsup:
